record.paper_title: Methods for Computing All Roots of a Polynomial Simultaneously - Known Results and Open Problems
record.context_brief: Optimal acceleration parameter for the SOR-like Weierstrass method
record.original_question: For the SOR-like modification of the Weierstrass method with acceleration parameter ω, what choice of ω gives the fastest convergence? In particular, determine the optimal acceleration parameter rather than merely local information such as the fact that ω = 1 is locally best.

evidence.quote: What is an optimal value of 0), which gives fastest convergence?
The optimal value of 0) is not known. However, it is known Yamamoto [39, p. 88 and the proof of Theorem 3.1] that 0) = 1 is locally best.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let p(z) be a monic polynomial of degree n ≥ 2 with n simple complex roots. The Weierstrass (Durand–Kerner) iteration for simultaneously approximating all roots is given, for an n-tuple z^{(k)} = (z_1^{(k)}, …, z_n^{(k)}), by

  W_i(z^{(k)}) = p(z_i^{(k)}) / ∏_{j ≠ i} (z_i^{(k)} − z_j^{(k)}),
  z_i^{(k+1)} = z_i^{(k)} − W_i(z^{(k)}),    i = 1, …, n.

For a real acceleration parameter ω > 0, define the SOR-like modification of the Weierstrass method by

  z_i^{(k+1)} = z_i^{(k)} − ω · W_i(z^{(k)}),    i = 1, …, n.

It is known that ω = 1 is locally optimal in the sense that the linearization at a root cluster is minimized there. The problem is: determine, for this SOR-like Weierstrass iteration, the globally optimal value of the acceleration parameter ω that yields the fastest convergence (rather than only the local optimality statement ω = 1).
artifact.status_search_result: Available literature on the SOR-like Weierstrass method (e.g., convergence analyses by Wang, Zheng, and others) discusses convergence regions and confirms that ω = 1 is locally best, but does not provide a globally optimal acceleration parameter. No source found establishes a closed-form global optimum, so the question appears still open.

status_evidence.title: A note on the convergence of the Weierstrass SOR method for polynomial roots
status_evidence.snippet: Convergence properties of the SOR Weierstrass method for the simultaneous approximation of polynomial roots are considered.
status_evidence.claim: Convergence of SOR Weierstrass is studied but the globally optimal ω is not given.

status_evidence.title: The behaviour of approximations of the SOR Weierstrass method
status_evidence.snippet: Behaviour of approximations of the SOR Weierstrass iteration is analyzed.
status_evidence.claim: Studies focus on behaviour and local convergence rather than a global optimal acceleration parameter.
